text:
Anya: Quick heads-up — marketplace GA is 2026-11-03. Need final plan for partner launch support credits (operational credits for joint customers). Who can own the allocation matrix?

Devon: I can draft allocation. Do we have total budget number or should I assume the $150k pool we discussed?

Matt: @Devon confirm with finance — last commit was $125k seeded, with potential +$50k if SAL exceeds threshold. I can confirm by EOD.

Lina: We need to tie credits to scorecard metrics in the QBR — prefer to gate by partner activation + integrated demo completion. Otherwise credits get abused.

Anya: Agreed. Proposed gates: 1) Listed on marketplace, 2) 1 customer trial started, 3) joint co-marketing asset live. If all 3 then full credit. Partial if 1–2.

Devon: Draft allocation table:
```
PartnerX: 40k
PartnerY: 30k
PartnerZ: 20k
Reserve: 35k
Total: 125k
```

Matt: If Finance ok with 125k we keep reserve 35k for post-GA claims. @Anya what's our timeline for approvals? :calendar: 

Anya: Need approvals by 11/10 to hit launch. Can someone escalate to legal for T&Cs re: credits? @Lina please loop legal.

Lina: On it — I'll ping legal team and add clause about 'non-transferable credits, expire 90 days'.

PartnerBot: New doc created: https://docs.redwood.com/partnerships/launch-credits-v1 — draft contains allocation table and suggested T&Cs

Devon: Quick question on reporting: do partners need to submit claim form or do we auto-apply upon verified customer activation?

Anya: Prefer auto-apply (less friction) but need verification webhook from marketplace. Engineering ETA?

Matt: I'll sync with eng-ops. ETA 2 sprints for webhook + dashboard. If that's tight, we use claims form for first month.

Lina: Scorecard impact: credits applied should increment 'marketing-assisted activations' metric, add to QBR deck as appendix.

Anya: OK — next steps: (1) @Matt confirm finance, (2) @Lina legal T&Cs, (3) @Devon finalize allocation + upload to doc, (4) Eng deliver webhook or fallback claim flow. Target review 11/09. :rocket:

Matt: Confirmed — I'll update finance by EOD.

Lina: Legal flagged IP co-branding line. Will propose wording in doc.

Devon: Uploading updated allocation now. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/partnerships/launch-credits-v1#allocation

Anya: Thanks team. Quick check-in tomorrow 10am PT? Short stand to lock approvals.

Matt: Works for me.

Lina: 10am OK.

Devon: See you then.
